name: @notambourine/brand-kit
description: The NoTambourine brand's golden set: tokens, element styles, deck theme, faces, and logo
author: NoTambourine LLC
//: No exports map: consumers import stylesheets and logo files by path, and vendor scripts walk fonts/ and logo/ whole. An exports map would have to restate the tree and would go stale the first time a file is added. No files field either, for the same reason - this installs from git, so what the repo holds is what a consumer gets.
